verdict.rationale: stagewise is a desktop agentic IDE with a built-in coding agent. Docs say it can read and edit files, run shell commands, drive browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate multi-step workflows, with parallel agent instances, slash-command skills, and diff review of each agent edit. Hands-on users report weeks of productive use, though the demo shows the agent choosing a hardcoded 298px height rather than idiomatic CSS. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of complex multi-step task delegation, since community evidence mainly covers UI tweaks and shows output-quality caveats.
